changelog:
Initial release: Alibaba Cloud Agent Data Gateway (Dgate) Skill – read-only access layer for enterprise data governance.

- Provides guided installation, onboarding, and configuration of the Dgate CLI and Agent identity.
- Supports discovery and inspection of enterprise data resources (catalogs, databases, tables, columns, indexes) and DataWiki semantics.
- Allows policy-governed, read-only queries via MCP or CLI, with strict runtime selection and explicit steps for onboarding.
- Clearly reports results, identity, permissions, and constraints; all operations enforced read-only with detailed policy rationale.
- Designed with secure handling of credentials; never exposes sensitive tokens or allows data mutations.
- Comprehensive error handling and ambiguity management per documented workflows.
summary: Install and configure the Dgate CLI, onboard an Agent identity, discover enterprise data, and perform policy-governed read-only access through Alibaba Cloud Agent Data Gateway (Dgate). Use when an AI agent needs to connect Dgate; create or inspect its Dgate identity or real instance permissions; discover catalogs, databases, tables, columns, or indexes; retrieve DataWiki business semantics; inspect security policies, masking rules, or audit records; diagnose Dgate calls; or run an authorized read-only query through Dgate MCP or CLI. Do not use for DMS change orders, direct database connections, or data mutations.
